assumptions: Stage 1 expected: smoke output per relationship, no thinking; high: +30% output and 2,000 thinking tokens per request.
Stage 2 system prompt and schema are priced as uncached input (conservative).
Stage 2 runs only for non-aligned Stage 1 results; expected share 65% (coherent synthetic cases are expected to pass); high and capNeeded assume every relationship is sent.

capNeeded = the sum of the guard reservations of every request (whole body at the cache-write rate + 2,048-token allowance + max_tokens 4,096, x1.1 data-residency factor). The existing runner refuses a cap below it. It is a ceiling, not a forecast.
